lecons.title: The flag and the motto of Cameroon
lecons.summary: The Cameroon flag has three colours, green, red and yellow, with a golden star on the red strip. Green stands for the vegetation of the south, red for power and authority, yellow for the sun and the north, the star for unity. The motto of Cameroon is Peace, Work, Fatherland.

lecons.title: The legislative arm of government
lecons.summary: The legislature is the law-making body of Cameroon. It has two houses: the Senate, the upper house, with 100 senators, 70 elected and 30 appointed; and the National Assembly, the lower house, with 180 members elected for 5 years. It makes the laws, amends the constitution and votes the budget.
